minio.description: MinIO S3 object storage on 145:9000 (buckets: iceberg, lake). Tools: list_buckets/list_objects/read_text_object/put_text_object/delete_object/presigned_url

doris.description: Doris FE MySQL protocol on 145:9030 (root no password, database omopdb). Note: Doris BE is down on this VM (AVX2 missing) - DDL/listing work but table queries may fail. Tools: list_databases/list_tables/describe_table/read_query/execute_sql

dagster.description: Dagster 1.13.12 orchestrator on 145:3000 (medgov code location).
